verdicts.evidence: lines 185, 187-200, 202-215, 218-237: Try again reloads, Save team name calls renameTeam, Send invite calls inviteMember and re-renders, Remove calls removeMember, 'Invite X back' calls inviteMember. No dead controls.

line 6: the document title hardcodes 'Northwind Studio' and is never updated from api data, so it is stale after a rename (line 193 only sets team.name) and shown even when the load fails. Table, name field and checkboxes do come from getTeam (lines 150-172).
lines 42-84: one screen of independent sections; no step depends on an earlier step or screen.
lines 45-50, 68-76: each task has one or two short inputs (team name; email plus role), single step, no free text longer than a line.
line 74: invite role preselects Member, the lower privilege. Enter in the forms only saves a name or sends an invite (lines 187, 202). Checkboxes reflect server values (line 169). No dialogs.
lines 43-83: settings screen with six occasional tasks from the brief and no single dominant frequent task.

lines 43-83: four sections (team name, members with role and remove, invite, email notifications) each match a brief task. No stat cards, feeds or extra panels. Last active column is server data about who is on the team.
line 49 is the only button with class primary; Send invite (75), Try again (39), Remove (159) and the undo button (227) use the plain style.
line 159: Remove is a plain bordered button in its own Actions column, type=button outside any form so Enter in a field cannot trigger it; not primary styled.
lines 155, 159: the owner row shows text 'Owner' and 'The owner cannot be removed' instead of controls. Selects and checkboxes are disabled only during their own request (lines 243-246, 250-253).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script.
lines 35-83 and message strings at 137-140, 195, 212, 227-252: all visible text concerns team settings; nothing mentions implementation, mock data or the request.

line 73 role hint sits at the role select and informs that choice; line 81 'Each change is saved as you make it' sits at the checkboxes; line 159 owner note replaces the remove control. No banners or general disclaimers.
No text of the 'this page lets you' kind. Remaining guidance is one short line at its control: line 73 (role), line 81 (checkboxes), line 63 (empty list pointing to the invite form).
lines 73, 81: the two helper lines add new information and restate nothing. Note the label 'Team name' (46) repeats its heading (44) verbatim, but it is a label, not a subtitle or helper text.
lines 35-83, 137-140, 195, 212, 227-252: no greeting, slogans, superlatives or exclamation marks; headings and messages are factual.
lines 39, 49, 75, 159, 227: 'Try again', 'Save team name', 'Send invite', 'Remove <name>', 'Invite <name> back'. Each starts with a verb and names its object where several are in view.

lines 127-128 map role and notification keys to words (Owner/Admin/Member, 'Weekly summary' etc); line 133 shows dates and 'Not yet signed in'; explain() (136-141) hides codes. No ids or enum values rendered.

lines 38, 137-140, 234, 245, 252: messages name the problem and the next step ('All 12 seats are in use. Remove someone or add seats', 'The connection dropped, so this was not saved. Try again.'). The raw ECONNRESET text is never shown.
lines 38, 137-140, 234, 245, 252 and the 'Problem: ' prefix (20): no 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals; the subject is the problem.
lines 63, 151: with zero members the text 'No one is on this team yet. Invite the first member below.' shows, and the invite form (66-77) directly below is the next step.
lines 37-40, 182: failed load shows its own panel with 'Try again' and hides content; lines 63, 151: an empty team shows a different message pointing to invite. No filters exist.

lines 182-185 load failure panel with retry; 196-197 and 213 show the error at the field and keep the typed value; 234, 245, 252 state the failure in the section and restore the control so the action can be repeated.

line 176 'Loading team settings...' at once; busy() (143-148) swaps button labels to Saving/Sending/Removing; lines 243, 250 disable the control and set a status. Calls last at most 1.5s so no progress or cancel is needed.
lines 42, 175-180: #content, which holds the table and the empty text, is hidden until getTeam resolves and render() runs; only the loading line is visible meanwhile.

lines 23-25: table in an overflow-x wrapper with overflow-wrap:anywhere on cells; 26-27 flex-wrap on actions and undo bar; line 133 null lastActive renders 'Not yet signed in'; esc() on names. No undefined/null paths found.
lines 258-260: beforeunload asks before leaving when the team name field differs from the saved name. Roles and notifications save immediately.
lines 69-70: the only format-bound field is labelled 'Email address' with type=email, which states the expected format before typing. Team name has no format rule beyond not being empty.
lines 45-50, 68-76: every field is required (team name; email; role select always has a value). No optional fields.
lines 187-190, 202-206: validation runs only in the submit handlers; there are no input or keyup listeners. The error is replaced by the status text on the next successful submit (194-195, 211-212).
lines 47-48, 70-71: each message paragraph sits directly under its input; line 20 adds the text prefix 'Problem: ' so the error is marked by more than red colour.
lines 190, 196-197: rename errors leave the input untouched; lines 205, 213: invite errors leave the email and role in place. The email field is cleared only on success (211).
lines 190, 205: on a rejected submit the field gets aria-invalid='true' and focus; lines 47, 70: inputs reference their message with aria-describedby.
lines 49, 75: submit buttons are never disabled; busy() (143-148) uses aria-busy only. Submitting empty shows 'Enter a team name.' (190) or the email message (206).
lines 143-148: busy() returns early when the button already has aria-busy='true' and shows 'Saving...' / 'Sending invite...' until the response, so a second press or Enter sends nothing.
lines 146, 191, 207, 222: button label changes synchronously on click; lines 243, 250: select or checkbox is disabled and a status line set at once; validation errors are synchronous (190, 206).

line 195 'Team name saved.'; 209-212 new row plus 'Invite sent to'; 225-227 row removed plus banner; 244 role status; 251 'Saved.'. Every catch block writes a failure message (197, 213, 230, 234, 245, 252).
lines 195, 212, 244, 251: inline status lines confirm a save or send that the control alone does not show (field text is unchanged, invite email is sent off screen). No success toasts or dialogs.
No setTimeout outside the server block. Errors are written into in-place regions (48, 55, 71, 82) and stay until a later success clears them; the undo bar (227) stays until used or replaced.

lines 218-232: Remove runs with no confirmation, then shows '<name> was removed and has lost access.' with an 'Invite <name> back' button that re-invites with the same email and role. Role changes are reversible in place.
Brief says a removed person can be invited again, and line 227 offers that, so removal is treated as reversible (FB-006). No permanent delete, overwrite or payment exists on the screen.
No confirm() calls and no dialog element in the markup (the dialog CSS at line 30 is unused). The only prompt is the browser's unsaved-changes prompt (258-260).
line 245: on a failed role change the select is set back to the previous role with 'The role for X was not changed.'; line 252: a failed notification flips the checkbox back with a message.
No modal dialog is opened anywhere; there is no dialog element or showModal call.
No modal dialog is opened anywhere; there is no dialog element or showModal call.
lines 43-83: sections follow the brief's task order (name, members, invite, notifications) directly under the h1; the members table is the largest block and nothing decorative precedes the work.
lines 35-45: h1 'Team settings', an empty status region, then the first form. No hero, greeting or intro panel.
No summary numbers, stat cards or charts in the markup.
No filter, search, sort or column controls exist.

All controls are native button, input, select and checkbox elements (47-49, 70-75, 155-159, 169). Focus is managed after actions: retry (182), undo button (232), select and checkbox refocused after saving (246, 253).
line 20: errors carry the text prefix 'Problem: ' besides red; success and error differ in wording; roles are text (155-157). No colour-only status.

lines 36, 48, 55, 71, 82: role=status and role=alert regions exist in the page before text is written into them (131, 195, 212, 234, 245, 252). Weakness: success text in rename-msg and invite-msg is sent through role=alert.
Only native select elements; no accordions, custom menus, disclosure buttons or tabs.

lines 9, 23-25: no media queries; the five-column table stays a table inside an overflow-x wrapper with overflow-wrap:anywhere, so it fits or scrolls at 375px, but whether names, emails and Remove buttons stay readable cannot be settled from source.
